page_title: CHE 2-2 ARS | Chelsea v Arsenal 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+6' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

90+5' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and David Raya easily makes the save.
90+4' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez makes a comfortable save.
90+4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+1' Yellow card. Ben White (Arsenal) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
88' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
86' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
84' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Bukayo Saka plays it into the box, and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:2.
84' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Cole Palmer is replaced by Reece James (Chelsea).
84' Here comes a substitution. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is brought on as a substitute for Raheem Sterling.
83' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
81' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
80' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Martin Odegaard walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
78' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Gabriel Martinelli will be replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).

77' 2 - 1 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted by Declan Rice (Arsenal), who gleefully finds the net from mid range with a first time effort. That makes it 2:1.
77' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
75' Gabriel (Arsenal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.
71' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
71' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
68' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) replaces Jorginho.
68' Substitution. Gabriel Jesus walks off the pitch and Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
67' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
66' Gabriel (Arsenal) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
66' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) dribbles into the box, but David Raya is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
66' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
66' Substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk makes way for Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea).
65' A lofted cross from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
64' Chelsea are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
63' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
61' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
60' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
60' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) makes a strong challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
59' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
59' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

58' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but David Raya pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.

57' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
57' Jorginho (Arsenal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
56' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
56' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.

55' Gabriel (Arsenal) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
54' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches a cross from the corner, but Robert Sanchez is alert to thwart the effort.

53' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but Robert Sanchez punches the ball away.
51' Jorginho (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
48' What a goal! Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes into the right post and behind the goalkeeper.
46' Half-time substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko is replaced by Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+2' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and David Raya pulls off an easy save.
45+1' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Declan Rice (Arsenal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thiago Silva (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Malo Gusto (Chelsea), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
42' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post.
41' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
39' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
38' Flag goes up against Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
36' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
36' Chelsea are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
34' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the corner with a short pass.
31' The ball is cleared after Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
30' What a big chance! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
29' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
29' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
28' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
27' Chris Kavanagh couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) and blew his whistle. Chelsea get a free kick.
27' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
26' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Now Arsenal have a corner.
25' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' The foul by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
24' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
24' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
22' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
22' Declan Rice (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
21' Declan Rice (Arsenal) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
18' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
17' The Arsenal players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past David Raya into the bottom left corner.
15' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to take the penalty!
13' The Chelsea players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
13' Referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Chelsea. Let’s see what happens!
13' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marc Cucurella (Chelsea).
12' William Saliba (Arsenal) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
11' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
10' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
10' Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul after Declan Rice (Arsenal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
9' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
8' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
7' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
6' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and it's Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
5' Arsenal keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
2' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will supervise the game today.
